ownerDecision.instruction: Close Gekta issue #4332 without weakening production acceptance. Prevent the asynchronously loaded legal-consent surface from interrupting an active mobile text-entry/keyboard cycle, while keeping consent fail-closed before submit.

constraints: Do not weaken viewport, overlap, draft, caret, localization, touch-target, exact-revision or zero-retry gates.
A late entitlement response must not steal focus from an active composer or invalidate keyboard ownership.
If consent becomes required while a draft is active, defer the modal until the next submit intent and intercept that submit before generation.
Escape must never record legal consent.
No backend, auth, model, database, registration, role or business-logic changes.
